verifiedEditorialEvidence.title: Later numbering explicitly identified
verifiedEditorialEvidence.description: Adams’s parenthetical editorial note calls the two Lecture 4 preparations 500 and 501 and the Lecture 5 preparations 502–507 in current literature. It says making/application methods had developed over thirty-four years and intentionally declines adding technicalities to a course intended to give principles.
verifiedEditorialEvidence.attribution: Adams edition editorial note, not Rudolf Steiner’s lecture speech

preparationNumbering.individual502to507Associations: The familiar six botanical labels below follow the later numbering convention and the Lecture 5 order. Adams capture 77 establishes the collective 502–507 range, not a separately numbered spoken identification of each plant.
preparationNumbering.preparation508: 508 is retained as the later/course index requested for horsetail. The mapped Lecture 6 calls the material Equisetum arvense tea/liquid manure, and the Adams numbering note does not mention 508. These witnesses do not establish who assigned 508 or when.
preparationNumbering.historicalBoundary: Later production standards, storage rules, application calendars, certification requirements and safe modern field instructions require distinct later sources. This map does not supply them.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: The parenthetical stance toward Venus/Mercury/Moon differs in wording/direction between OCR witnesses.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Lecture 1 distinguishes silicon and oxygen percentages, while Lecture 2 gives differing percentages for silica (Creeger 47–48; Adams 27–28). Terminology and numerical basis cannot safely be harmonized.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Map silica's proposed role without a settled numerical abundance claim. Native check and modern compositional source needed if a number is taught.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: An individual sentence locates directly radiating cosmic activity differently above/below in the two witnesses, despite the larger shared account of distant forces received below and nearer influences above.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Mark the sentence unresolved; explain the shared larger structure without pretending the textual discrepancy has been repaired.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Creeger's soul-quality wording corresponds to Adams's explicit astral principle.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Make the spiritual status of the claim clear; do not invent a substantive doctrinal disagreement from translation vocabulary.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Creeger uses rhizome wording; Adams says stem formation. Both distinguish the potato formation from a root.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: No exact drawing colours are certified until the native drawings/plates are checked.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: A late Adams list omits oxygen, and a following triad differs from Creeger, although both openings establish five constituents including oxygen.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Preserve the discrepancy in the source map. Use the explicit opening five-element list for a paraphrase; do not silently repair a quoted Adams sentence.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Carbonic-acid/carbon-dioxide and etheric/ethereal wording reflect translation and historical terminology.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Explain terms in context and avoid treating the spiritual functions as modern chemical identities.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Material numerical discrepancy in supplied OCR witnesses; unresolved without PDF/German verification.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Retain both as historical readings, never average or silently convert into a course recipe.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.canonicalWording: the third window here to the first footpath
internalTranslationComparisonTable.comparisonWording: the third window here to the first foot-path, about 1, 200 square metres (between a quarter- and third-acre)
internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Adams includes an area figure absent from the corresponding Creeger lecture capture; discussion then refers to about one-fifth acre.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Keep demonstration and discussion separate, with bucket/scaling still unsettled; do not manufacture a precise universal ratio.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.canonicalWording: on account of the acids that are formed
internalTranslationComparisonTable.comparisonWording: on account of the formation of oxygen
internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Substantive wording discrepancy in supplied OCR; neither image nor German verified.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Use canonical draft paraphrase with an unresolved comparison note; no quotation that silently substitutes the other wording.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Different named agricultural conditions, not interchangeable translations for a verified modern diagnosis.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Map the same Q&A location with separate wording; do not turn the answer into a confirmed treatment for either condition.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.canonicalWording: mesentery; answer clarifies peritoneum, not tripe
internalTranslationComparisonTable.comparisonWording: Rindergekrose (bovine mesentery in Lecture 4); answer clarifies peritoneum, not tripe
internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Both retain imprecise anatomical wording; Adams’s parenthetical lecture cross-reference conflicts with the mapped Lecture 5 occurrence.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Cite Lecture 5 for the indication and Discussion 3 for clarification. Preserve the source terminology without inventing anatomical equivalence or a Lecture 4 passage.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.canonicalWording: Chamomilla officinalis; dog chamomile is closer than the rejected garden specimen and could be used
internalTranslationComparisonTable.comparisonWording: Chamomiilla officinalis in OCR; dog camomile may be used if need be
internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Botanical name/OCR and specimen-based reply do not establish modern species equivalence.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Retain the specified wild plant and qualify the substitute as tentative; obtain independent botanical verification for any practical course.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.canonicalWording: sugar-beet nematode; whole insect; ventral nerve-cord versus spinal cord
internalTranslationComparisonTable.comparisonWording: nematode of the root crops; entire insect; abdominal marrow versus spinal marrow
internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: The historical animal grouping and Adams marrow wording should not become a modern taxonomic/anatomical claim.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Teach the source’s lower/higher-animal distinction with attribution and retain Creeger terminology in the draft.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.canonicalWording: Venus visible with constellation of the Scorpion in the background; Venus has to be behind the sun
internalTranslationComparisonTable.comparisonWording: Venus visible with Scorpio constellation in the background; Venus must be behind the Sun
internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Both witnesses retain an unresolved observational/geometrical ambiguity.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Do not infer calendar dates, replace constellation with a later zodiac calendar or manufacture a verified astronomical instruction.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.comparisonWording: Aquarius, Pisces, Aries and Gemini and on to Cancer; Sun in Taurus specified separately
internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Creeger brackets Bull in the sequence; Adams omits it from that particular list while giving Taurus as the example.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Distinguish editorial bracket from lecture wording; preserve the Aquarius–Cancer range and trial qualification.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.comparisonWording: quartz or silica or even orthorclase or felspar in OCR
internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Minor wording/spelling difference with materially broad original choice.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Keep the original offered alternative rather than impose a quartz-only later standard.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.comparisonWording: ethereal; chalky or limestone element; potash; potassium
internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Different English vocabulary and variable substance/element usage; not evidence that modern nutrient categories and spiritual roles are identical.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Use canonical terminology and explain the material versus modeled activity in the relevant passage.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Terminology difference; neither gives a quantified phosphorus addition or an independently demonstrated mechanism.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Explain the attributed phosphorus relation without claiming conventional bulk phosphorus fertilization.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.canonicalWording: Drawings 8–17 with Color Plate references in these captures
internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Image OCR is not a usable visual witness; not every reference has a matching visible designation.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Maintain edition-specific verbal references and label any later explanatory diagram original.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.canonicalWording: substitution generally possible except nettle; stag bladder alternative uncertain; insect timing to be tried
internalTranslationComparisonTable.comparisonWording: same distinctions in the corresponding lecture and discussions
internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Technical incompleteness coexists with confident spiritual efficacy assertions.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Keep uncertainty at the specific question rather than pretending either universal doubt or complete tested instructions.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.canonicalWording: hand stirring favored; fine machine spray accepted; farming without machines impractical
internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: A general machine prohibition is not supported.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Compare the different processes instead of collapsing them into a machine-free farming rule.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.canonicalWording: Original named materials, no spoken numbering in mapped captures
internalTranslationComparisonTable.comparisonWording: Editorial note identifies current 500/501 and 502–507, but not 508
internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Modern labels require explicit later/editorial attribution.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Use the catalog for orientation while marking 508’s numbering origin unestablished and avoiding an invented 1924 numbering scheme.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.canonicalWording: Advantages of spontaneous heating; loose piling and long-term usefulness questioned
internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Neither a blanket endorsement nor a blanket rejection.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Retain the competing considerations and short-term versus long-term distinction.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.canonicalWording: potash/lime transmute into nitrogen; silicon into an unnamed element; food primarily supplies forces
internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Not merely alternative words for measured nutrient cycling or conventional dietary uptake.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Preserve the claims with attribution and a separate evidence boundary.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Canonical Creeger explicitly says wet meadows in the fungal/microbial discussion; Adams says meadows without this adjective. Retain canonical qualification and do not generalize to any meadow.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Use only if material to understanding; preserve canonical wording and explicit uncertainty.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Flaxseed in Creeger and linseed in Adams name the complementary feed alongside carrots; the model and need for a second feed agree.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Use only if material to understanding; preserve canonical wording and explicit uncertainty.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Both witnesses pair the farm cycle with a qualification that complete self-sufficiency is impossible under present economic conditions. The qualification must accompany the cycle.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Use only if material to understanding; preserve canonical wording and explicit uncertainty.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Lecture 7 drawings 18–20 correspond textually to Adamsdiagrams 15–17; Lecture 8 drawings 21–24 to 18–21; Discussion 4 drawings 25–26 to 22–23. This is a numbering correspondence, not visual image verification.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Use only if material to understanding; preserve canonical wording and explicit uncertainty.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Both records identify Dr. Vreede for provisional calendar calculations and Steiner for the calendar-development remark. Do not attribute Vreede’s year-specific interval solely to Steiner.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Use only if material to understanding; preserve canonical wording and explicit uncertainty.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Both contain the 12–14 day Moon-period formulation; Gardner separately marks German ambiguity and tropical/sidereal tension. Preserve uncertainty rather than deriving precise scheduling.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Use only if material to understanding; preserve canonical wording and explicit uncertainty.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Adams Supplement overlaps remembered indications in Creeger Appendix B; it is not Creeger Appendix C/Pfeiffer commemorative essay. Creeger Appendix A handwriting and Gardner notes likewise lack matching sections in the assigned Adams end matter.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Use only if material to understanding; preserve canonical wording and explicit uncertainty.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Creeger names Bottomley’s auximones; Adams renders the reported substances as auxines. Do not conflate either historical report term with a current established fertilizer mechanism.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Use only if material to understanding; preserve canonical wording and explicit uncertainty.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Adams Supplement includes recalled 150 horns for 18500 acres and a sainfoin seed amount. These are supplementary local testimony, not lecture formulas or canonical Creeger quantities inferred from this map.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Use only if material to understanding; preserve canonical wording and explicit uncertainty.

internalTranslationComparisonTable.finding: Direct June 11 address advises experiments and limited acreage; Pfeiffer later recalls broad application with experiments coming later. These are different dated/transmitted records, not an identical statement to harmonize.
internalTranslationComparisonTable.handling: Use only if material to understanding; preserve canonical wording and explicit uncertainty.

studentTranslationNoteRule: Show a translation note only when it materially improves understanding. Preserve unresolved numerical, botanical, diagram and calendar wording; do not silently harmonize it into a recipe.

conceptualTeachingOrder: Farm individuality as a qualified organizing principle
Preparation rationale before materials and numbers
Later practice, certification and modern evidence
Whole-farm synthesis; observation separated from interpretation

legacyAudit.role: Use the migration classification to preserve useful GA 230, GA 136, Courtney, observation and research material as background/optional study before removing obsolete pages.

evidenceBoundaries: Keep 1924 indications, later practice, current Demeter requirements and modern evidence separate.
Observed soil, habitat or feeding outcomes do not establish etheric, astral or cosmic causes.
Whole-farm differences do not isolate preparation effects.
Preserve uncertain quantities, substitutions, calendar interpretation and historical health assertions without operative learner instructions.
Retain both confident spiritual assertions and specific technical uncertainty in the source.
limitations: Both supplied PDFs exceed the executor transfer limit of 32 Mi B; no visual PDF page, drawing or plate verification was performed.
The Creeger/Gardner export ends during Literature Cited at capture 192, displayed 88%; bibliography is partial, and the remaining index and colour plates are absent.
Appendix A handwritten material has poor OCR; illegible details have not been reconstructed.
Some wording, numerical and botanical details disagree between the translations and remain unresolved.
Source study does not independently validate the proposed spiritual, agronomic or health mechanisms.
Full uploaded files remain private; public output contains original explanations, concise excerpts and authored notes.
First-introduction entries describe verified conceptual map loci; they do not certify earliest every-word occurrence.
Supporting GA 230/GA 136, new modern sources and current standards require their separate source checks before publishing claims.

conceptRecordContract.firstIntroduced: Earliest mapped conceptual treatment; reference its numbered lecture/discussion in the global source index. This is not a literal-word-first-occurrence claim.
conceptRecordContract.materialTranslationDifference: Issue ids resolve to the internal comparison table. An empty list means no separate material difference was established in the reviewed maps.
conceptRecordContract.sourceAuthority: Attributed 1924 Steiner model unless the record explicitly identifies later/editorial or recalled material.
conceptRecordContract.evidenceBoundary: No spiritual/medical mechanism or practical efficacy is established by this consolidation; modern evidence and current requirements need their separate sources.
